mapper.sql: SELECT r.report_id, r.patient_id, r.image_id, r.medical_record_id, r.lab_result_id, r.fusion_response_json, r.image_result_json, r.case_text, r.lab_data_json, r.doctor_signature, r.doctor_advice, r.is_deleted, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, p.patient_name, x.image_name FROM fusion_analysis_report r LEFT JOIN medical_patient p ON p.patient_id = r.patient_id LEFT JOIN chest_xray x ON x.id = r.image_id

SELECT r.report_id, r.patient_id, r.image_id, r.medical_record_id, r.lab_result_id, r.fusion_response_json, r.doctor_signature, r.doctor_advice, r.is_deleted, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, p.patient_name, x.image_name FROM fusion_analysis_report r LEFT JOIN medical_patient p ON p.patient_id = r.patient_id LEFT JOIN chest_xray x ON x.id = r.image_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId} AND r.image_id = #{imageId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fusion_analysis_report ( patient_id, image_id, medical_record_id, lab_result_id, fusion_response_json, image_result_json, case_text, lab_data_json, doctor_signature, doctor_advice, create_by, create_time, remark, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{imageId}, #{medicalRecordId}, #{labResultId}, #{fusionResponseJson}, #{imageResultJson}, #{caseText}, #{labDataJson}, #{doctorSignature}, #{doctorAdvice}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark}, 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE fusion_analysis_report
patient_id = #{patientId}, image_id = #{imageId}, medical_record_id = #{medicalRecordId}, lab_result_id = #{labResultId}, fusion_response_json = #{fusionResponseJson}, image_result_json = #{imageResultJson}, case_text = #{caseText}, lab_data_json = #{labDataJson}, doctor_signature = #{doctorSignature}, doctor_advice = #{doctorAdvice}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(),
WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND is_deleted = 0
